summary: Silvercorp Metals Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching a news release about securing RMB 1.5 billion (~US$220 million) syndicated term loan facilities with a syndicate of international banks, oversubscribed 2x from a target of RMB 1 billion. The 3-year facilities include floating and fixed tranches with interest rates based on CNH HIBOR plus margin or fixed at 3.67%. Proceeds support general corporate purposes and working capital. This is a routine financing arrangement, not a special situation.
